jobs_results.title: Salesforce CRM Specialist (Marketing Cloud)
jobs_results.description:
Salesforce CRM Specialist (Marketing Cloud)

Estamos en la búsqueda de personas como tú, que buscan un cambio y desean comenzar la semana con entusiasmo. En Smileat, destacamos la importancia de las personas que conforman nuestro equipo, construyendo relaciones.

¿Quiénes somos?

Smileat es una empresa española que nació en 2015 de la mano de dos emprendedores con la visión de revolucionar el mundo de la alimentación infantil con alternativas 100% ecológicas, saludables y sostenibles.

Hoy en día somos la marca líder en alimentación infantil ecológica, gracias a

un equipo emprendedor, joven, inconformista y apasionado por la alimentación y la sostenibilidad.

Actualmente estamos expandiendo nuestra estrategia a nivel internacional, entrando en nuevos mercados como Portugal, Rumanía, Polonia, Moldavia, Grecia, Chipe y Costa Rica.

¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos un CRM Specialist con experiencia en Salesforce. El candidato ideal tiene que tener un conocimiento profundo de Marketing Cloud y... haber trabajado con Service Cloud. Será capaz de convertirse en la pieza fundamental de la estrategia de marketing automation, en la amplificación y mejora de la base de datos.

Queremos incorporar un perfil muy proactivo, resolutivo y con ganas de seguir creciendo profesionalmente dentro de una empresa con importantes índices de crecimiento interanuales.

¿Cuáles serán tus retos?
• Colaborar en la definición de la estrategia de CRM de Smileat, estableciendo los objetivos y definiendo un plan de acción. Y por supuesto medir y analizar el rendimiento de nuestra estrategia.
• Serás la persona responsable de gestionar la base de datos de clientes y las activaciones de marketing, de desarrollar los procesos y liderar el día a día para optimizar la información que obtenemos de los clientes y mejorar la experiencia del cliente.
• Gestión diaria de Salesforce (configuración, personalización, automatizaciones…). Así como enseñar a otros miembros del equipo.
• Marketing automation: gestionarás nuestras campañas, journeys, embudo, etc. de todos los canales de marketing en los que interviene Salesforce para potenciar el nurturing, scoring, fidelización y recurrencia de los clientes.
• Implementación y gestión de procesos de atención al cliente.
• Monitorización y análisis del rendimiento de las campañas, las acciones y las operaciones; así como creación de informes, dashboards, etc. tanto B2C como B2B.
• Como parte del departamento de Digital & eCommerce colaborarás con los departamentos de atención al cliente, marketing o comercial para mejorar la experiencia del cliente en toda la empresa.

¿Qué te hará triunfar con nosotros?
• Experiencia en Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
• Imprescindible conocimientos avanzados de SQL.
• Valorable conocimientos de Apex, HTML/visualforce, Javascript, CSS, Python.
• Si tienes experiencia con Shopify, puntos extra.
• Persona con iniciativa y proactividad.
• Capacidad de análisis y resolución de problemas.
• Capacidad de trabajo en equipo.
• Conocimientos de marketing digital.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?
• Entorno de trabajo dinámico y ambiente de trabajo inmejorable
• Contrato indefinido
• Retribución flexible
• Formación para empleados
• Descuento para empleados
• Jornada completa en nuestra oficina en Gran Vía.
• 60 días de teletrabajo
• Horario flexible
• Ventajas como jornada intensiva parte del verano, café y fruta en la oficina y subvención para participar en carreras

¡Si estás interesado/a, manda un correo con tu CV con el asunto “SALESFORCE” a veronica.velasco@smileatbaby.com cuéntanos por qué estás interesado/a en unirte a nuestro equipo.

Smileat se compromete a realizar sus procesos de selección sin discriminación por razón de discapacidad, edad, sexo, salud, orientación sexual, identidad de género, expresión de género, características sexuales, nacionalidad, origen racial o étnico, religión o creencias, territorio o cualquier otra condición o circunstancia personal o social, así como velar por el respeto a los derechos humanos.

¡Únete al equipo Smileat

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Technical Lead
jobs_results.description:
OCA Global somos un grupo internacional de capital privado referente en Inspección, Inspección de vehículos, Certificación, Ensayos, Consultoría, Prevención, Formación, Sostenibilidad y Medio Ambiente, con más de 12 años de experiencia.

Somos un equipo de más de 4.000 personas, distribuidos en una red de más de 90 oficinas en todo el mundo, y prestamos nuestros servicios en más de 60 países, haciendo posible un mundo mejor, garantizando que nada quede al azar y con un alto compromiso en todo lo que hacemos.

Debido a nuestro crecimiento y expansión precisamos incorporar un/a Salesforce Technical Lead para el departamento de IT en nuestras oficinas centrales ubicadas en Sant Cugat.

En Dependencia directa del Responsable, tu misión será contribuir al éxito operativo y estratégico de la empresa mediante el diseño, desarrollo y mantenimiento eficiente soluciones Salesforce.

Tus funciones principales serán:
• Diseñar, implementar y probar nuevas funcionalidades y características en
•... Salesforce para satisfacer las necesidades de la compañia.
• Desarrollo, test y despliegue de desarrollos en código Apex.
• Colaborar con el equipo interno y externo garantizando que se cumplan las
• mejores prácticas.
• Tutorizar al resto del equipo interno.
• Definir/Refinar el flujo de trabajo del equipo de desarrollo
• Hacer un uso adecuado de las diferentes alternativas del entorno Salesforce (Flows, Apex, LWC, etc.) para garantizar la cobertura de los requerimientos.

¿Qué requerimientos precisas para la posición?
• Experiencia de 2 años en puesto similar.
• Título universitario en Informática, Ingeniería de Sistemas o relacionado.
• Nivel de inglés B2.
• Experiencia con Salesforce en sus diferentes nubes, así como del ecosistema Salesforce.
• Experiencia en proporcionar e implementar soluciones técnicas.
• Conocimiento avanzado en Apex, Visualforce, Componentes Lightning para la creación de soluciones personalizadas adaptadas a las necesidades de negocio.
• Sólido conocimiento de los límites de Salesforce y los procesos de testing.
• Conocimiento de procesos de release management y del uso de herramientas de gestión de código y de despliegeue como github o bitbucket.
• Experiencia en integración con otros sistemas utilizando SOAP y REST. Conocimiento de integración utilizando Mulesoft es un plus.

¿Qué competencias buscamos?
• Orientación a cliente, capacidad de comunicación efectiva, trabajo en equipo y liderazgo.

Se valorará...
• Contar con certificaciones de Salesforce en el ámbito de desarrollo.

¿Qué te ofrece OCA Global?
• Contrato indefinido a Jornada completa.
• Horario de Lunes a Jueves, jornada completa. Viernes jornada intensiva.
• Horario intensivo durante Agosto y vísperas de festivo
• Día 24 y 31 de Diciembre festivo.
• Formar parte de un grupo empresarial con crecimiento constante en un sector en auge.

(Si tienes una minusvalía del 33% o mayor acreditada por un Organismos Oficial háznoslo saber, nos interesa hablar contigo)

Si crees que este puede ser tu siguiente paso profesional envíanos tu candidatura y la analizaremos en detalle. Nos encantará poder charlar contigo.

Te invitamos a visitar nuestra página web www.ocaglobal.com donde podrás saber más sobre nosotros.

¿Quiénes somos?

Desde OCA Global Corporate trabajamos conjuntamente para ofrecer servicio y soporte a todas las líneas de negocio del grupo, con el objetivo de ayudarles a crecer y desarrollarse

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Integration
jobs_results.description:
Our client is a B2B AI automation software company that is on its mission to help B2B organizations raise buying temperature using AI.

Job Description:

We are looking for a Salesforce developer who has published apps to the Salesforce app store.
Specifically, we're looking for someone who has published apps for integrating between Salesforce and external databases.

Requirements:
• 2-3 years experience.
• Having experience publishing and creating an app on the App Store that has to do with integrations.
• Experience with making sure that the application meets security standards for B2B companies.
• English - B2+.

Benefits:
• Part-time salary.
• Remote-first environment with flexible working hours
• Work from home.

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Consultant
jobs_results.description:
En JAKALA IBERIA no paramos de crecer. Cada semana contamos con nuevas oportunidades que cubrir y, en esta ocasión, buscamos un Salesforce Marketing Cloud Consultant para incorporarse en el equipo de Salesforce y poder crecer de la mano de grandes profesionales.

Funciones:
• Trasladar requerimientos de negocio técnicos en soluciones sobre Marketing Cloud
• Realizar las configuraciones necesarias sobre todos los módulos de Marketing Cloud
• Realizar y dar soporte a desarrollos sencillos con SQL, HTML, CSS y AMPscript en Marketing Cloud .
• Dar soporte a usuarios técnicos y de negocio sobre el uso y best practices sobre el ecosistema Salesforce Marketing Cloud (email studio, journey builder, mobile push, SMS, cloud pages, etc.).
• Participar en el diseño de soluciones, modelo de datos, implementación e integraciones
• Documentar las soluciones implantadas
• Reporting
• Comunicación con la agencia creativa de la compañia

Requisitos:
• Al menos 18 meses de experiencia en proyectos de... implementación/desarrollo de SFMC, como especialista, con capacidad de actuación en Email Studio, Content Builder, Journey Builder, Contact Builder y Automation Studio.
• Si la experiencia es menor en tiempo, el conocimiento debe ser demostrable.
• Debes ser capaz de ejecutar tanto Journey Builder como las funciones básicas de Automation Studio → SQL (nivel básico, pero es independiente y autónomo en ello), Imports y Exports.
• En Ampscript deberías ser capaz tanto de personalizar un email, como de consultar tablas y ejecutar bucles.
• Comprender el modelo de datos a seguir en un proyecto de SFMC.
• Conocer la integración de SFMC con SFCore vía Connector.
• Necesitamos que tengas conocimiento del stack tecnológico -completo, no solo SFMC- de Salesforce. Entendimiento del concepto Cloud y las posibilidades dentro del ecosistema Salesforce.

Nice to be:
• Contar con alguna certificación
• Bootcamp de programación o formación en Salesforce / SFMC.
• Trailhead bastante avanzado (en particular las nubes de Salesforce CRM)
• HTML/CSS o Javascript
• Capacidad en SSJS (Automation Studio)

¿Por qué nosotros?

Ofrecemos un ambiente de trabajo relajado pero exigente donde todos los miembros del equipo tienen su propia autonomía para lograr sus objetivos y asignaciones. Algunos de los beneficios que nos ayudan a incrementar ese salario emocional son:
• Modelo híbrido de asistencia a la oficina (2 días).
• Tres semanas al año de full remote.
• Seguro médico con Adeslas.
• Gympass para cuidar tu salud física y mental.
• Retribución flexible, gracias a la tarjeta Cobee.
• 28 días de vacaciones al año.
• Path de carrera adaptado a tus inquietudes profesionales.

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Consultant
jobs_results.description:
Omega CRM, a leader in Technology Solutions, is looking to develop its Marketing practice with a Salesforce Marketing Cloud Consultant.

Main duties:
• Investigate, create, and recommend innovative marketing automation and martech solutions.
• Conduct analysis on marketing automation and martech solution implementations. Assist in high-level architecture design for marketing automation and martech solution implementations by choosing the most suitable platform.
• Implement infrastructure and functional cloud marketing architecture.
• Create policies for activating automated communications that map the customer's journey.
• Perform basic functional and specialized marketing tasks.
• Ensure that automated cloud communication activations are effectively utilized.
• Decide which processes are suitable and necessary to be executed in the cloud for implementing marketing automation solutions.
• Determine the assets and organization of automations that best fit the cloud implementation.
•... Provide functional consulting services to ensure that automated communication processes run smoothly.
• Implement automated communications and marketing automation processes to meet customer needs at various touchpoints.
• Implement the latest technological advancements and marketing technology solutions.
• Conduct test trials, diagnose errors, and resolve issues in the use of marketing automation and martech tools.
• Document processes and track system performance metrics.

Experience:
• Proven experience in creating marketing campaigns with Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
• Knowledge with Ampscript is a plus.
• Previous experience in database management, preferably in a similar role.
• Knowledge with the automation software and relevant performance evaluation.
• Experience with CRM platforms (Salesforce).
• Knowledge to manage marketing projects.
• Advanced level of English. Another language is desirable.

What do we offer
• Permanent contract.
• Flexible Schedule. We make it easy. Balance your professional and personal life.
• Certifications plan. Improve your skills and get the official certificate from our main partners.
• Home Office. You decide and we support you.
• Flexible retribution (public transport ticket, Ticket restaurtant, …).
• Health insurance.
• OMEGA in action. Our commitment to a better society is not just an intention
• Professional development: Evolve, grow and get where you want to go.

About Us

Our mission is to accelerate the business experience (BX) of its customers. In concrete terms, our 360 solutions allow business transformation and acceleration by means of technology and data applied to Customer #OmnichannelExperiences in fields such as #CustomerServices, #eCommerce, #Analytics or #Marketing. We target companies from different fields such as: #Retail, , #Manufacturing but also #Education, #NonProfit, #NGO etc. We are one of the top 3 partners of #Salesforce in Europe. Our team is composed of more than 450 people of 22 nationalities based in Spain and France, who have wide knowledge and experience that understands business processes and technology while enjoying what it does. Key to our success is the knowledge of our people. We are an innovation and Outstanding Knowledge award-winning, Salesforce Consulting Partner. Our priority is the well-being of the team. We foster a collaborative culture, involved and supported by our company values: #Talent, #flexibility, #commitment and #innovation. We bring them to everything we do. #TogetherWeGrow

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Technical Administrator
jobs_results.description:
🛫 WHO ARE WE ? 🛫

FCM Travel is one of the largest and fastest-growing global business travel management companies with a worldwide reach in almost 100 countries. FCM in Barcelona represents a tribe of more than 110 teammates, united by a single mission: developing and ensuring the best services and technology products to support business travelers in their trips around the globe.

🚀 THE JOB

We are seeking a Technical Administrator that is motivated to provide advice and guidance around technical design decisions on our Salesforce platform, carry out key platform administration responsibilities, with a focus on low code configuration. You will be responsible for managing the Salesforce Platform as well as delivering enhancements and enabling new features/products to support our business needs. This role is analytical, hands-on, and the right candidate enjoys digging into requirements and working towards a solution in a collaborative environment.

We have recently completed... rebuilding our 15+ year legacy Salesforce instance. Our focus now is to continue to add value by enabling our business through technology while further globalizing our people and processes. The business processes we enable in our Salesforce are end to end as we cover Marketing, Sales, Implementations, Account Management, Operations, and Support. We have also recently deployed an Omni Channel solution that is critical to our business and their interactions with customers. This is leveraging Service Cloud and will continue to expand with the use of Service Cloud Voice, Einstein, GPT, and integrations with our other important platforms. This is truly an amazing opportunity to help take FCTG to the next level and change the way we do business with our customers while strengthening our position as a leader in travel tech.

🎯 YOUR MISSIONS
• Align business processes with Salesforce best practices and help ensure solutions deliver measurable business benefits
• Collaborate on solution design
• Assist with translating functional business requirements to technical design focused on enabling the business and support creation of User Stories within a Product Backlog
• Assist with identifying unnecessary technical debt
• Provide escalated technical user support – particularly post deployment (bugs/issues and data requests where Level 1, 2, 3 support teams require assistance)
• Design, configure, develop solutions using the full Salesforce toolset focused on declarative first
• Configure objects, fields, page layouts, lightning record pages, record types, etc in SFDC, ensuring alignment with requirements and existing security and structure
• Work closely with business analysts and stakeholders to review business process and optimization of current solutions
• Review, manage, regression test - Salesforce releases (3x per year)
• Assist with testing/QA (Peer Review)
• Support UAT process by working with Business Analyst and key stakeholders on developing and executing test plans
• Support Deployment process by working within Sandbox environments and moving components through environments
• Work with Developers to provide direction where advanced solutions are required
• Create and maintain detailed documentation for technical design, case/ticket notes, lessons learned
• Communicate and update project status for tasks assigned
• Work with Support, Governance, Enablement teams on roll out to Users

👀 Our Ideal Candidate ?
• 3-5 years hands on experience with Salesforce, ideally with an administration role
• Certified Salesforce Administrator or higher
• Experience with Lightning UI
• Experience in training and supporting nontechnical staff in the use of Salesforce
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, as well as troubleshooting expertise
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
• Ability to prioritize effectively and escalate issues as required
• Strong working knowledge of Salesforce configuration (Process Builder, Formula fields, Validation rules)
• Strong ability to develop and support Salesforce analytics including complex reporting and dashboards
• Experience working with Agile development teams using SCRUM
• Strong ability to perform data cleansing and mass updates for users
• Demonstrates constructive conflict resolution skills to ensure a positive outcome for all involved
• Maintains objectivity and can see the big picture rather than reacting emotionally to the problem
• Knows how to embrace conflict to achieve a win/win outcome for all parties involved
• Knows how to use available resources to solve problems
• Thinks outside the box when overcoming problems
• Encourages and assists other team members to solve problems
• Experience with implementing Salesforce is an asset
• Experience with deployments is preferred
• Strong understanding of Salesforce core data model (Sales & Service Cloud)

🎁 WHY FCM SPAIN ?

As well as being a fun company to work :
• We offer you an interesting package: Participation in the private mutual insurance company + Attractive remuneration
• 30 days off/year + reduced time during summer + Barcelona bank holidays
• Discounts to access your favorite gym (Andjoy app!)
• Free language platform
• Employee Retention share scheme
• Several activities organized by the ambassadors!
• Free coffee, drinks, snacks and fruits at the office!
• A modern and human management focused on personal development, to support you in the evolution of your career

We truly think personality is important so bring it on

jobs_results.title: Corporate- IT Application Specialist - Salesforce
jobs_results.description:
Join Amcor and you can be part of the team that makes the packaging of the future better for people and our planet.

Here at Amcor, we work together every day to make a positive impact on the lives of millions of people across the globe by providing packaging for essential products, including food, beverages, pharmaceutical, medical, home and personal care. We are sustainability leaders in our industry, and we were the first global packaging company to commit to making all our products recyclable or reusable by 2025. In addition, our products play a vital role in a circular economy as we are working toward 30% recycled material across our portfolio by 2030, and we are one of few packaging companies committed to using science-based targets and achieving net zero emissions by 2050.

We are always looking for talented and passionate individuals who are motivated to make a difference. Working at Amcor means you will have a unique opportunity to be a part of an organization that is... committed to innovating and driving new solutions to create more sustainable packaging solutions.

To find out more about our commitment to sustainability and about Amcor, visit www.amcor.com I LinkedIn I Glassdoor I Facebook I YouTube

Job Purpose

The Salesforce Application Specialist III is focused on continually improving and enhancing the Amcor Salesforce platform, gathering requirements and feedback, designing scalable best practice solutions, and managing the product road map.

This position requires a deep understanding of the Salesforce platform with expertise in the Sales, Service, and Voice Cloud environments, experience with Manufacturing Cloud desired. The position also requires someone who can understand both the current setup and Amcor business objectives, to quickly identify areas of improvement.

The Salesforce Application Specialist III should be comfortable with change management and governance, as well as communicating, prioritizing, and managing all aspects of a Salesforce project.

The Salesforce Application Specialist III will collaborate with stakeholders at all levels, must have the ability to translate technical information, and clearly explain design options and their potential impact.

Job Dimensions
• Multi-national manufacturing business culture – strong customer focus, delivery of tangible products and benefits, cost management.
• This role is a part of Amcor’s Global IT Application Delivery Team
• Responsible for Salesforce platform including integration, performance, and security.
• Responsible for ensuring that solutions are implemented within the organization in such a way as to meet or exceed our customers’ expectations.

Principal Accountabilities
• Partners with business functions to expand business knowledge and increase functional expertise in multiple areas while being able to instinctively recommend to-be-solutions to resolve business needs.
• Leads strategic projects that drive value (cost improvement and/or top line growth)
• Establishes to-be solution alternatives with recommendations and participates on the best approach to pilot and deploy solutions
• Fully understands and applies the Amcor System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) process when executing system modifications through the effective translation of business requirements into IT solution design. Ensuring all implications of the request have been considered, reviewed, and documented.
• Leads the writing of functional requirements, configures, develops test plans and scripts, conducts component, integration and user acceptance testing
• Leads data conversion, data validation efforts, cut over activities, and post live support for system implementations
• Works with development resources to confirm the requirement is being met while measuring and evaluating the effectiveness of the solution and makes necessary adjustments before full deployment
• Manages advanced production support issues and service requests through the use of ServiceNow while committing to timely resolution and SLA adherence
• Partners in building the logical architecture diagrams for the system you support, including landscape management while also understanding the physical architecture and landscape components.
• Manages large IT projects, effectively applying the Amcor Project Management Methodology with accountability for milestones while engaging and leading appropriate Project Team Members (IT and Business). Responsible for defining project requirements, project scope, timeline, resources, obtaining Business and IT agreement on these items prior to project start
• Mentor and develop expertise through delegation of activities, knowledge sharing, and process documentation review/adherence
• Deep understanding of Salesforce including:
• All aspects of user and license management including new user setup/deactivation, roles, profiles, permissions, public groups, OWD, sharing rules
• User support tickets
• Monitor and improve user adoption
• New user and ongoing user training
• Identify and gather requirements, translating into best practice, scalable solutions with a focus on exceptional user experience
• Salesforce configuration changes, including (but not limited to): Flow, assignment rules, approval processes, fields, page layouts, record types, dynamic layouts, apps, actions, custom settings, mobile administration, dashboards and reports
• All Sales Cloud configuration and customizations specific to Amcor
• Service Cloud including Voice
• Commerce Cloud and Digital Experience
• Management of integrated applications and third party suppliers
• Data management to improve Salesforce data quality, implementing rules and automation as needed
• Proactive system maintenance including Security Reviews, Release Updates, Health Check, and Optimizer
• Sandbox environment management
• Identify unused or underutilised platform features
• Own the communication of any platform changes to end users and stakeholders
• DevOps/release management experience
• Understanding of basic triggers/Apex code knowledge

RELATIONSHIPS

Internal
• All Global IT Teams
• Business Group IT Teams
• IT Directors & Senior Managers
• Key Stakeholders

External
• Salesforce
• External Consultants
• Multiple Integration Vendors

Qualifications/Requirements
• Strong Salesforce product knowledge and at least 5+ years of Salesforce Administration and development hands-on experience
• 5+ years of work experience in business process and or IT, including software development and project management experience; experience in a large global environment preferred.
• Bachelor’s degree required, in computer science, management information systems, business or a related field. Master’s degree is desirable
• Remote employees will need to travel at times for team meetings and projects as required
• Certified Salesforce Administrator and or Developer
• Additional Salesforce certifications such as Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder
• Fluent in English (company working language).
• Effectively communicates verbally and in writing.
• A positive and pro-active attitude.
• Acts with integrity and honesty, displays high ethical conduct and holds themselves accountable.
• Exhibits flexibility in response to changing demands, works additional hours as needed and is prepared to travel as required.

Amcor is a global leader in developing and producing responsible packaging solutions for food, beverage, pharmaceutical, medical, home and personal-care, and other products. Amcor works with leading companies around the world to protect their products and the people who rely on them, differentiate brands, and improve supply chains through a range of flexible and rigid packaging, specialty cartons, closures, and services. The company is focused on making packaging that is increasingly lighter weight, recyclable and reusable, and made using an increasing amount of recycled content. In fiscal year 2022, 44,000 Amcor people generated $15 billion in annual sales from operations that span 220 locations in 43 countries. NYSE: AMCR; ASX: AMC
